data.name: Hasina
data.gender_notes: Hasina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'hasan', meaning beautiful, good, excellent or sweet. In Bengali and Urdu, it means 'jewel'. The name Hasina carries the meaning “Sweet, Delightful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Bengali, Urdu. Parents who choose Hasina usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet, delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the essence of kindness, compassion, and beauty. It signifies a gentle and nurturing soul, who spreads joy and happiness wherever she goes.
data.etymology: Hasina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sweet, Delightful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasina total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
